patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,2 +1,40 @@
-def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
-    pass
+def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
+    numbers = {
+        10: "Ten",
+        9: "Nine",
+        8: "Eight",
+        7: "Seven",
+        6: "Six",
+        5: "Five",
+        4: "Four",
+        3: "Three",
+        2: "Two",
+        1: "One",
+        0: "no"
+    }
+    
+    verses = []
+    
+    for i in range(take):
+        current = start - i
+        next_num = current - 1
+        
+        current_word = numbers[current]
+        next_word = numbers[next_num]
+        
+        # Handle pluralization
+        bottle_current = "bottle" if current == 1 else "bottles"
+        bottle_next = "bottle" if next_num == 1 else "bottles"
+        
+        line1 = f"{current_word} green {bottle_current} hanging on the wall,"
+        line2 = f"{current_word} green {bottle_current} hanging on the wall,"
+        line3 = "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,"
+        line4 = f"There'll be {next_word.lower()} green {bottle_next} hanging on the wall."
+        
+        verses.extend([line1, line2, line3, line4])
+        
+        # Add empty string after each verse except the last one
+        if i < take - 1:
+            verses.append("")
+    
+    return verses
